subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should maintainers split Feishu outbound hook parity from normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening, and pick or repair one existing configured-`beforeDeliver` hook PR as the outbound path?
rationale: The outbound bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent fix changes security-sensitive hook ordering and the separate `inbound_claim` request changes plugin claim authority before agent routing.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Land one canonical outbound `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending` parity fix first, then track normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening separately.

options.title: Fold into the hook umbrella
options.body: Move this Feishu evidence under the broader outbound-hook issue and keep this item only as context for a separate inbound-claim tracker.

options.title: Solve all requested hooks together
options.body: Use one larger design PR for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Land one canonical outbound `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending` parity fix first, then track normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice centers on plugin hook semantics and security-sensitive observer behavior, where history and discussion point to vincentkoc as the strongest routing signal.
